notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Raindancer Version 1.1.2[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added "Statistics" menu that keeps track of kills & deaths for each boss. Access the menu by pressing Escape (or Start on gamepad) during gameplay and selecting "Statistics"
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Raindancer Version 1.1.1[/h1]

[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor pixel adjustment on the position of the 'crit section' of the chargebar
[/list]

[b]CONTROLS[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now change the order of the blessings you have acquired. 
[/list]

[u]Keyboard&Mouse:[/u] Hold down either of the Switch Blessings buttons (Q or E) or the Examine Blessing button (R). Press right-mouse-click to move your current blessing one slot to the right. Press middle-mouse-click or mouse4 (side button) to move your current blessing one slot to the left.

[u]Gamepad:[/u] Hold down either of the Switch Blessings buttons (L Bumper or R Bumper) or the Examine Blessing button (L Trigger). Press the "Y/Triangle" button to move your current blessing one slot to the right. Press the "X/Square" button to move your current blessing one slot to the left.

tags.feature: You can now change the order of the blessings you have acquired.

notes.title: [Retroactive] Patch Notes v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Raindancer Version 1.1.0[/h1]

[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Portuguese (BR) translation
[*] Adjusted shadow on Baanda's face on Tempest mode
[*] New drop-down menu for "full game" speedrun timer with options: NONE, NORMAL, and ALL BOSSES. Hopefully this completes the setup for all speedrun versions. When doing the All Bosses speedrun, you must use the "Skip Outro & Credits" option when killing the Shears or else your timer will reset.
[/list]

tags.feature: New drop-down menu for "full game" speedrun timer with options: NONE, NORMAL, and ALL BOSSES.

notes.title: [Retroactive] Patch Notes v1.0.10
notes.content:
[h1]Raindancer Version 1.0.10[/h1]

[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked Malvo's archers to aim their arrow-draw animation a little bit better towards the player
[*] Game difficulty setting (story/tempest toggle at lantern) is now saved/loaded
[*] Fixed bug with Steam thinking the game is still running after closing it
[/list]

[h1]SPEEDRUN IN-GAME TIMER OPTIONS ADDED[/h1]
[list]
[*] The launcher now has a "Speedrun Timers" checkbox, click it to open the panel
[*] Choose which timers you want, and what location you want them on the screen
[*] Timers are reset on "Reset Game" regardless of whether Clear Progress is checked or not
[/list]

[b]FULL GAME TIMER:[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Full Game" timer will have white-colored text.
[*] The "Full Game" timer will start when the Single-Player or Two-Player button is pressed at the Title Menu. It will stop when the Shears are killed.
[/list]

[b]INDIVIDUAL BOSS TIMER:[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Individual Boss" timer will have grey-colored text.
[*] [For most bosses, with cutscene] The "Individual Timer" will start when the player regains control.
[*] [For most bosses, NO cutscene] The "Individual Timer" will start immediately when the fight is triggered.
[*] [Shears, with cutscene] The IT will start when the player regains control
[*] [Shears, NO cutscene]  The IT will start when the Shears-Heart becomes vulnerable
[/list]

[b]MISCELLANEOUS:[/b]
[list]
[*] When you hit a trigger point to transition to another room, the next room is loaded and can cause a micro-stutter. The timer will not run during that stutter, so a slower computer will not be penalized (but the IGT can diverge from what an external "real-time" timer would show)
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed bug with Steam thinking the game is still running after closing it

notes.title: [Retroactive] Patch Notes v1.0.7
notes.content:
[h1]Raindancer Version 1.0.7[/h1]

[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] Lowered volume a bit on 'creaking branches' SFX in outro
[/list]

[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*] Blessing of Gasa: [Removed] +25% damage [Added] +100% leaf dash regeneration
[/list]

[b]BUGS[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with very large sized fonts missing characters
[*] Fixed clicks possibly propagating through open menus into the menu underneath them
[/list]

[b]SPEEDRUN CONVENIENCE CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] A new option to skip the Outro Cutscene and Credits is added to the menu (Escape key / Start button on controller to open the menu) when Bramble falls to the ground after stumbling away from the Shears tree.
[*] The "Reset Game" menu now has a checkbox to let you choose if you want to Clear Progress or not. 
[*] If you have killed all bosses on both difficulties and press Single Player / Two Player button from the Title Screen, you'll spawn in front of the Gateway
[/list]
